scope: Complete single-image FP32-B implementation, actual reference trajectories, durable native jobs and browser/CLI verification; no formal model certification or portable release
installed_binary_identity: All three installed executables match the recorded build artifacts byte-for-byte

model_package.file_sha_validation: Every graph/constant is hashed by the successful native worker before execution; final inventory freshly verifies manifest, constants and recorded byte counts

historical_evidence: native-manifest.json, framework-manifest.json, web-manifest.json and foundation-manifest.json remain original snapshots. Their old source hashes are not expected to equal changed current files.
omitted_large_build_inputs: Model checkpoints, export intermediates, ncnn source tree and system runtime libraries remain in their existing private caches, identified by dependency/source locks and export manifests. No large weights are copied into documentation.
